## Validated contributions on 2026-11-15

Replaced with a cheap object-shaped check plus structural inspection of parsed JSON keys. Added `test/source-map-json-escapes.test.js` for escaped-key and indexed-map canaries, strings, Buffers, BOM/whitespace, COO/SCO/SNO and programmatic SCO publication; ordinary JSON and binary assets remain accepted. Added test to manual semantics workflow. Green Linux/Windows run 43709319407 at SHA `6aee06b52ed9e2eb3eb2f42132b5c3a7b651a473`. Report: `im-results/escaped-source-map-keys-2026-11-15.md`. This is build-time accidental disclosure prevention only, no client anti-extraction guarantee.

2. **Immutable local identity wrappers:** Extended `src/properties.js` `proveLocalObject` to track `const f=x=>x`, block arrow return, and `const f=function(x){return x;}` (including named expression), with plain params and a simple returned parameter. Existing lexical, source-observer, call-site, escape and ambiguity checks remain. `test/local-identity-wrapper.test.js` runs 6 accepted and 7 declined/counterexample cases in COO/SNO against native runtime; cross-file property flow not modified. It now runs the offline source-only `sims/offline-normalize.js` attacker: both generated private-key labels per accepted fixture are removed with identical fixture behavior. Test integrated into `manual-transform-safety.yml`. Green Linux/Windows run 43709847473 at `33e533f91761f07957e54cf083290013952b465c`. Report: `im-results/local-identity-flow-2026-11-15.md`.

3. **SNO hot path evidence:** Added two million-iteration identity-wrapper workloads to `sims/hotpath-mixed.js`; each asserted 2 renamed private fields. Green Ubuntu run 43709949069 at `100096a728d4197f4260b716514051e914f4e729` (Node 22, warm-up 8, alternating 15 trials). Arrow original 1.414788 ms, transformed 1.431309 ms, ratio 1.01167737×. Function-expression original 1.420208 ms, transformed 1.451176 ms, ratio 1.02180526×. These pass 2.5× *for this warmed SNO sample*; cold COO and arbitrary workload budgets remain unverified. Static normalizer undoes the syntactic key layer, so no meaningful reconstruction resistance demonstrated.

## Research integrity

All scores here describe finite tests. The adversary has complete client code/runtime in COO, owner code/runtime/files in SNO, and unlimited legitimate RPC requests in SCO. Locally protected labels are mechanically removed; server-private SCO remains vulnerable to chosen-input functional cloning and small work RPC latency. Never promote a test count or “green CI” to proof of tamper resistance, authorized-execution enforcement or general 2.5× compliance.

## Fifth verified contribution: CSS source-map annotation disclosure

- ECMA-426 §7.1.2.2 specifies CSS block comments `/*# sourceMappingURL=... */`, and MDN shows CSS source maps embedding original preprocessor source. Existing `src/source-maps.js` preflight covered .map files, disguised raw JSON maps and JavaScript AST comments, but published CSS opaque assets unchanged even when a data URL carried map `sourcesContent`.
- Added `hasCssSourceMapDirective` scanning real CSS block comments while skipping quoted strings and CSS escapes, with conservative malformed UTF-8/NUL rejection for .css assets. `assertNoSourceMapDisclosure` calls this in all COO/SCO/SNO input preflight and SCO served asset construction. `test/css-source-map-annotation.test.js` covers CSS base64 inline map canary, CSS external URLs, @/# markers, UTF-8 BOM, deceptive string text and unrelated comments, bad encodings, and safe byte-identical CSS. Added test to manual transformation workflow.
- Linux and Windows semantic/JSDoc focused green [run 43713706583](https://github.com/FlareZ123/obfs/actions/runs/43713706583), exact SHA `8e1ed078c4e52ba8dad53e3b91adc9db4bb2fab9`. Following change `9e6ef78fe31b25c526850b84f6070c9edbf2026a` simplified only error propagation and corrected a stale doc comment; final main full validation is requested separately.
- Report: `im-results/css-sourcemap-annotation-2026-11-15.md` commit `8835e6f01f4716eaf4318cd76725c0256a6d3013`. Sent prospect and request for counterexample to Agent25 at `communications/agent25/2026-11-15T1220Z_agent15_css-sourcemap-annotation-gap.md`. This is a publishing refusal of one standardized leak channel, not general source confidentiality, tamper-proofing or client-mode security.

## Sixth verified contribution: Wasm source-map custom section disclosure

- ECMA-426 §7.1.2.3 defines Wasm `sourceMappingURL` custom section with map URL bytes. Standard `WebAssembly.Module.customSections` API inspects metadata from a compiled module. Added `hasWasmSourceMapDirective` in `src/source-maps.js`; any Buffer-valued opaque asset with `\0asm` magic gets runtime validation and a check for the exact named custom section regardless filename, including disguised .bin. Fail-closed on malformed Wasm with magic, preserve ordinary valid wasm metadata and non-Wasm binary buffers. This is build-time and has no JavaScript runtime dispatch.
- New `test/wasm-source-map-annotation.test.js` constructs actual valid Wasm custom section with base64 map + original-source canary, checks runtime section parser and refusal in all COO/SCO/SNO and SCO handler, proves innocuous custom sections unchanged, invalid wasm rejection and other binary acceptance. Added test to manually dispatched cross-platform safety workflow.
- Initial focused CI [43714272990](https://github.com/FlareZ123/obfs/actions/runs/43714272990) failed typecheck `Buffer<ArrayBufferLike>` not assignable to `BufferSource` for `new WebAssembly.Module(code)`; corrected with owned `new Uint8Array(code)` in commit `0838ea49d750e5e16e4f031190a90f8b1cfd94fb`. Linux and Windows targeted semantics/JSDoc green [43714426858](https://github.com/FlareZ123/obfs/actions/runs/43714426858), exact head SHA `26e9922bfb46e443b71f807346414d166a40b8a0`. Report `im-results/wasm-sourcemap-annotation-2026-11-15.md`, updated status commit `efaefaf236d833d080c9132247ac5462851201a1`. This prevents one standard reference leak, does not prevent arbitrary source text in Wasm data/debug sections or disassembly.
- Full manual integration [43714025306](https://github.com/FlareZ123/obfs/actions/runs/43714025306) green at SHA `36cd02498342092d427a6b2206b657bb320d50f6` before latest Wasm gate, after CSS gate.
